hook_line: INDIA PROTESTS, VANCE WALKS BACK H-1B REMARK

stats.label: of approved H-1B petitions annually are accounted for by Indian professionals
Less that Vance claimed H-1B workers earned than American citizens in similar positions
The PERM suspension is separate from H-1B status, according to the MEA

diaspora_bullets: Vance was responding to a question from an Indian immigrant who became a US citizen five years ago
His wife, Second Lady Usha Vance, is the daughter of Indian immigrants
news_summary: US Vice President JD Vance said his rhetoric was imperfect and that calling H-1B workers 'indentured servants' was not a criticism of the visa holders themselves, after India's Ministry of External Affairs called the term deeply offensive.
payoff: Vance's clarification does not reverse the PERM suspensions, change any wage claim he made, or alter H-1B rules.
